The mean shifts toward the majority gradually: at 70/30 it is still between the modes and clips the kettle, and only at a skew of about 80/20 does it leave the kettle. And at no share does regression go around on the minority side: it doesn't choose, it averages. Averaging isn't inevitable: in the CARLA driving simulator, with 50/50 demonstrations, regression turned right in 98% of runs, that is, it collapsed onto one mode. But neither outcome is guaranteed.

Neighboring steps come from different components: a step left, a step right, and Ada shuffles in the middle until she runs into the kettle. With an independent 50/50 pick, T steps give (T − 1)/2 component switches on average; there are fewer visible side switches because Ada doesn't have time to cross over. Регрессия с MSE выберет самое частое дей: Will MSE regression pick the most frequent action?
Нет: она выдаёт условное среднее, при 70: No: it outputs the conditional mean; at 70/30 that's a point between the modes
Только если данных много: Only if there's a lot of data
В лаборатории при 70 на 30 регрессия зад: In the lab, at 70/30 regression clipped the kettle: the mean shifts toward the majority gradually and leaves the kettle only at a skew of about 80/20.
Достаточно заменить MSE на L1?: Is it enough to replace MSE with L1?
Да, медиана всегда выбирает одну из мод: Yes, the median always picks one of the modes
Нет: L1 даёт медиану по каждой координат: No: L1 gives the median of each coordinate, and at 50/50 the solution isn't unique
L1 ничем не отличается от MSE: L1 is no different from MSE
При перевесе одной стороны медиана выбир: When one side outweighs the other, the median picks it; with an even split any answer between the modes will do. The OpenVLA-OFT authors themselves note that L1 may fail on “truly multimodal” data.
Гауссиана с выученной дисперсией — это у: Is a Gaussian with a learned variance already a distribution over actions?
Да, раз есть дисперсия: Yes, since it has a variance
Нет: мода у неё одна, среднее остаётся с: No: it has one mode, and the mean is still the mean
Да, если дисперсия большая: Yes, if the variance is large
Сэмплы такой гауссианы попадают «between: Samples from such a Gaussian land “between two modes”. In RT-1, replacing the bins with a Gaussian cost 29 percentage points on familiar tasks. In the lab, a mixture with one component drives into the kettle, just like regression.
Модель хранит для каждого измерения дейс: A model keeps a separate bin table for each action dimension and picks the dimensions independently. Does it know the full action distribution?
Да: бинов много, любая форма распределен: Yes: there are many bins, so any distribution shape is covered
Нет: по каждому измерению — да, а связи: No: it does for each dimension, but the links between dimensions aren't in the separate tables
Да, если измерений не больше двух: Yes, if there are at most two dimensions
В интерактиве с двумя шагами объезда око: In the interactive with two detour steps, about half of the actions zigzagged: step 1 one way, step 2 the other, even though there were no such demonstrations. Picking dimensions one at a time, autoregression, brings the link between them back, as in RT-2 and OpenVLA.
ACT с CVAE на тесте выбирает разные стил: Does ACT with a CVAE pick different motion styles at test time?
Да, каждый раз сэмплирует новый стиль: Yes, it samples a new style every time
Нет: на тесте латент z ставят в ноль, и: No: at test time the latent z is set to zero, and the policy outputs the same thing every time
Только если операторов было несколько: Only if there were several operators
CVAE помогает при обучении: без него на: The CVAE helps in training: without it, success on human demonstrations dropped from 35.3 to 2%. At execution the latent is zeroed, so there's no choice of style. More on ACT in lesson 1.7.
Генеративная модель сама по себе даёт пл: Does a generative model give smooth motion on its own?
Да, она же выбирает моду: Yes, it picks a mode, after all
Нет: если сэмплировать каждый шаг незави: No: if you sample every step independently, the policy jumps between modes
Да, если обучена на многих данных: Yes, if it's trained on lots of data
В лаборатории смесь с выбором стороны на: In the lab, the mixture that picked a side at every step jumped between sides and clipped the kettle. Action chunks help, but side switches also happen at chunk seams.
Сглаживание стыков — усреднение перекрыв: Does smoothing the seams, that is, averaging overlapping chunks, safely remove side switches?
Нет: среднее пачек из разных мод — то же: No: averaging chunks from different modes is still averaging modes
Да, если пачки длинные: Yes, if the chunks are long
В интерактиве со стыками сглаживание вел: In the seams interactive, smoothing led Ada into the kettle almost as often as executing the latest chunk. The RTC paper says it is “not guaranteed to produce valid actions”.
Диффузия выигрывает у регрессии, потому: Does diffusion beat regression because the data is multimodal?
Да, это доказано на всех бенчмарках: Yes, it's been proven on every benchmark
Не всегда: на стандартных бенчмарках усл: Not always: standard benchmarks have almost no conditional modes, but with truly conflicting demonstrations, yes
Нет, мультимодальность ни при чём: No, multimodality has nothing to do with it
По оценке Mazza и соавторов число условн: By the estimate of Mazza et al., the number of conditional modes on Push-T, LIBERO and MetaWorld is 1.01 to 1.07. But on data from different operators in ALOHA Unleashed, diffusion gets 70% versus 25% for L1 regression.
